objective: Measure whether IA-managed Bateia catalyzes IA-managed native web research relative to the same IA-managed native web research without Bateia.
estimand: IA_INTERNET_BATEIA minus IA_INTERNET within the same case, model, reasoning effort, output contract and native-web budget.

case_source.interpretation: All three public cases form STEP0030_CALIBRATION; no protected TEST case is opened.

arms.control: IA_INTERNET with 1..3 native web searches and no MCP
arms.treatment: IA_INTERNET_BATEIA with exactly one completed bateia_recommend before 1..3 native web searches

unknown_policy: Preserve Unknown for unsupported web event encodings, unavailable runtime observations, opaque causal links and unknown cost. INCONCLUSIVE is a neutral answer state, never an automatic win or loss.
execution_authorization: The user explicitly authorized execution of Step 0030 on 2026-09-03. Behavioral dispatch remains conditional on a sealed contract and passing preflight.
claim_boundary: Three calibration pairs can diagnose methodology and produce exploratory evidence only; they cannot establish general Bateia uplift.
